result.reason: The operative language gives Company the preferred 30-day written-notice right, including during an active SOW, and requires refund of prepaid fees allocable to the post-termination period. Contractor cannot terminate while an SOW remains uncompleted and must give 90 days' notice. However, allowing Company to terminate an SOW “in part” exceeds what is needed to meet the playbook and may create avoidable scope and fee-allocation ambiguity. Otherwise, the language is professional and preserves unrelated commercial intent.
